notes: Dictum now shows its Terms of Use the first time it starts, and you press Continue to accept them; Settings > About has buttons for the Terms of use and the Third-party notices. The cloud clean-up and cloud speech consent dialogs now say what hands-free mode sends with each part, and the Offline only description now names Check for updates and cloud speech. Settings > Storage names its folders more precisely, and Calibration says Downloading only once you have agreed to the download. Qwen2.5-3B is no longer offered as a clean-up model, because its licence allows non-commercial use only: if you chose it, Dictum uses the recommended clean-up model instead, and its 2.1 GB file stays in your models folder for you to delete.
